text_block_list.name: Heart's Friend A
text_block_list.text:
Is everyone ready? Look at the camera, 
ready, go!

text_block_list.name: Heart's Friends
text_block_list.text:
Hanshin Juvenile Fillies time is here~♪ 
Peace, peace♪

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: P... Peace.

text_block_list.name: Heart's Friend A
text_block_list.text:
...Mm, okay! Everyone looks super cute♡ 
I'll send it to your hearts! Thanks for 
joining in too, Messiah-chan!

text_block_list.name: Heart's Friend B
text_block_list.text:
"Wow, it's amazing that you came all the 
way out here! Are you here to cheer for 
Heart too, Messiah-chan?"

text_block_list.name: Heart's Friend A
text_block_list.text:
Ehh, isn't it more like scouting out the 
competition? After all, they're classmates 
aiming for the Tiara route!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"...That's about it. My debut was a little 
delayed, after all."

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
—I've come to see with my own eyes how the 
two leaders are doing.

text_block_list.name: Heart's Friend A
text_block_list.text:
Right~? Girls who do well in the Hanshin 
JF often go on to make waves on the Tiara 
route next year!

text_block_list.name: Heart's Friend B
text_block_list.text:
"I mean, that's our Heart for ya! She's 
already ready for a GⅠ! Everyone's looking 
at her like she's the coolest girl ever—"

text_block_list.name: Heart's Friend C
text_block_list.text: It's not here!!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: I-Is something the matter?

text_block_list.name: Heart's Friend C
text_block_list.text:
The magazine's Hanshin JF special preview! 
I bought it for Heart because it features 
all the hottest contenders, but...

text_block_list.name: Heart's Friend C
text_block_list.text:
"Heart's name... is nowhere to be found, 
though?!"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
What!? That's nonsense! Not doing a 
special feature on me...

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"...Just kidding. It can't be helped! 
Rather than mentioning my name... they'd 
want to dedicate those pages to Craft, 
after all."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Yes, the one commanding the most 
attention from the public today is—Rhein 
Kraft."

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"While her lack of racing experience is a 
concern, she possesses more than enough 
potential to make up for it. She's sure to 
shine in the Classic races!"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
...That's absolute praise. Though, I 
completely agree!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Because Craft is... a special girl.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Oh, I know!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"It's actually okay that Craft is getting 
so much attention! Because that way—"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
It'll make my victory even more 
impressive! I can really make my presence 
known for next year♪

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Fufu. You too.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Because, even right before a GⅠ race... 
your brow isn't furrowed like it used to 
be.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"You're that confident, aren't you? —In 
how I am now, without having changed my 
running style."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I couldn't find the words right away. 
But... I knew better than anyone just how 
much stronger she had become. That's 
whyâ

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Good! Never forget that confidence.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
With the running I've honed together with 
you— I'm going out there to win!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"One last question. Do you think I can do 
it?"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: "Ahaha, thanks! I'm off!"
choice_data_list:
(...I really need to work on my English 
pronunciation.)

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
"Go for it!" "Go, Craft!" "Give it your 
all, everyone!"

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Wah...! A-Amazing...—

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
The passion is incredible, isn't it?! 
That's a GⅠ race for you!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Ah, Heart-san...!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
...Craft, just now... You breathed a sigh 
of relief, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: ...! I-I d-d-didn't do that at all!!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Heheh, there's no need to panic!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
It was your first GⅠ race, so you were 
nervous, right? That's why seeing me made 
you feel at ease.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Still, from here on out... Just looking at 
me needs to send a chill down their spine.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: We're…… rivals, after all. Right?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah. Yeah...!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Fufu! Looks like your switch has been 
flipped!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Craft, you are special... I know that if 
we clash, it will be a tough race.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Even so... I'm going to lead today's race!
